description: ROSES. Film-Cabaret is a documentary cinéma vérité, following Dakh Daughters - an intellectual freak cabaret band, created by seven actresses under the roof of Kyiv experimental contemporary theater Dakh. The video diary spans almost five years, following Dakh Daughters since their first show, titled 'Roses' - after their first popular song 'Rozy / Donbas', written long before Donbas region became the war-torn zone of the so called 'Russian Spring'. ROSES. Film-Cabaret is about being an artist under extreme conditions of the pain and loss, realizing that during the war a natural self-defense would be creation - in terms of the art as well as motherhood. Film presents a special take on the Maidan revolution, as we are following the events through the eyes of the female artists, through women's eyes. Life is a cabaret for the characters of the film, so ROSES is a film-cabaret, where music hardly stops, pace never slows, and acting becomes something genuinely sincere. We see through Dakh Daughters' lives only to find out that all what happens behind the curtain is for the sake of being put on the stage.

title: My Lucky Star
description: This is a romantic drama set against the backdrop of power, identity, and social justice. The story follows Akira, a brave village girl who enters a forced marriage with Lakshya, a billionaire who hides his identity as a poor caterer. While Akira joins the Vardhan Group to stop the demolition of her village’s livelihood, Lakshya secretly helps her while maintaining his disguise. Their relationship evolves from awkward strangers to partners who fight injustice together. The show explores themes of class divide, hidden identity, ambition, love, and rural empowerment. With humour, romance, and emotional confrontations, the narrative builds towards Akira proving that compassion and roots are more powerful than wealth.

description: In 2015, Tongzhou officially became the sub-center of Beijing, and the people were very happy. Sai Duoxi's family, who lived in the alley of the old wharf of the North Canal and were doing renovation, received the demolition payment as promised. The five brothers and sisters of the Sai family quarreled over the demolition payment. In the process, the hidden problems of each family were exposed one after another. Sai Duoxi was diagnosed with a terminal illness. Facing his children who were like a pile of scattered sand, he was always unable to treat them equally, and he fell into distress and reflection. His greatest wish was to see his children live in harmony before he died, and this hope could only be placed on his eldest daughter-in-law Wen Jiayin. Wen Jiayin, the eldest sister-in-law who was always gentle and docile but determined in her heart, began to clean up the "mess" of the Sai family in the name of her family. With her efforts and inspiration, the five brothers and sisters finally corrected their shortcomings according to their father's expectations, united, turned danger into safety, and realized their father's long-cherished wish of "family harmony brings prosperity".

title: Class 4 Hindi - All Chapters Rimjhim NCERT Book
description:
कक्षा 4 हिंदी प्लेलिस्ट में आपका स्वागत है! यह संकलित वीडियो कलेक्शन कक्षा 4 के छात्रों के हिंदी सीखने के मार्ग में मदद करने के लिए तैयार किया गया है। चाहे आप छात्र हों, शिक्षक हों या अपने बच्चे की सीखने को समर्थन करने वाले माता-पिता हों, यह प्लेलिस्ट आपकी मदद करने के लिए यहां है।

इस व्यापक प्लेलिस्ट में, आपको कक्षा 5 हिंदी पाठ्यक्रम के विभिन्न विषयों और अवधारणाओं को कवर करने वाले वीडियो देखने को मिलेंगे। प्रत्येक वीडियो को स्पष्ट और सरल तरीके से प्रस्तुत किया गया है, जिससे छात्र सामग्री को प्रभावी ढंग से समझ सकें।

प्लेलिस्ट पाठ्यक्रम के साथ मेल खाती है और मूलभूत अवधारणाओं से शुरू होकर धीरे-धीरे उन्नत विषयों की ओर बढ़ती है। वीडियो व्याकरण, शब्दावली, पठन समझ, लेखन कौशल और हिंदी साहित्य जैसे महत्वपूर्ण क्षेत्रों को कवर करते हैं |

title: Databases and SQL for Data Science with Python
description:
Working knowledge of SQL (or Structured Query Language) is a must for data professionals like Data Scientists, Data Analysts and Data Engineers. Much of the world's data resides in databases. SQL is a powerful language used for communicating with and extracting data from databases.
In this course you will learn SQL inside out- from the very basics of Select statements to
advanced concepts like JOINs. 
You will: 
-write foundational SQL statements like: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE 
-filter result sets, use WHERE, COUNT, DISTINCT, and LIMIT clauses 
-differentiate between DML & DDL 
-CREATE, ALTER, DROP and load tables 
-use string patterns and ranges; ORDER and GROUP result sets, and built-in database functions
-build sub-queries and query data from multiple tables 
-access databases as a data scientist using Jupyter notebooks with SQL and Python
-work with advanced concepts like Stored Procedures, Views, ACID Transactions, Inner & Outer JOINs through hands-on labs and projects
You will practice building SQL queries, work with real databases on the Cloud, and use real data science tools. 
In the final project you’ll analyze multiple real-world datasets to demonstrate your skills.

title: Guns & Gulab
description:
This story is a high-voltage romantic thriller set against the backdrop of crime, power, and emotional conflict. It explores the journey of Naina, an innocent yet resilient girl, whose life takes a drastic turn when she crosses paths with Kabir Ahuja—a ruthless mafia don who falls obsessively in love with her.
The narrative blends intense romance with action, betrayal, and family drama. At its core, it questions morality, power dynamics, and the meaning of love—whether love can be forced or must be earned.
With strong emotional stakes, dramatic twists, and a dominating male protagonist versus a morally grounded female lead, the story promises a gripping mix of passion, revenge, and transformation.

description:
Mafia Girl is a high-voltage romantic crime drama with dark humor and emotional depth.
Mayra, who rules the underworld with fear, experiences love for the first time—with a man who has nothing but honesty.
Sunny, always exploited and underestimated, finally becomes someone worth fighting for.

Every episode blends romance, danger, and drama with shocking twists.
At its heart, it asks—can love survive when it is born in violence?

title: Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai [Hindi]
description: Following his legendary father-son battle against Yujiro Hanma, Baki faces a new threat: the resurrection of Japan's greatest swordsman, Miyamoto Musashi. As warriors like Doppo Orochi, Jack Hanma, and Kaoru Hanayama return to the fight, the stage is set for an unprecedented clash the strongest underground fighter vs. the legendary samurai, in a cross-era showdown.

Three of its inhabitants: Shuta, Ran, and Koki, have been best friends since childhood, but after a deadly incident, everything changed. A year later, reunited for the first time, they receive a mysterious phone call. On the other line is a familiar voice from a friend who's supposed to be dead. Together, they'll have to save their home.

title: Handyman Saitou in another world [Hindi]
description: Handyman Saitou has never felt special in his life. When he's dropped into a medieval fantasy world, he gathers a party of unique beings to survive. Surrounded by a heavy warrior, a spell-forgetting wizard, and even a divine fairy princess, he yearns to be helpful. But after Saitou saves everyone during a raid, it's clear that having a handyman on an adventure isn't just useful, it's essential.

description: Sosuke Kaburaya is a detective struggling to make ends meet. While on a case, he happens upon Sara da Odin, a princess from another world who wields magical powers. Soon enough, both Sara and Livia's positivity begins to rub off on Sosuke and the neighborhood's cast of characters.

title: A Burglar for a Night
description: In Hong Kong, William Neal helps Kirk Marden fight off a group of rowdies. Back in New York, Kirk again turns to William's assistance when his father's rivals plot to take control of the Marden railroad. William teaches Kirk how to open safes so that Kirk can procure papers outlining the takeover plans. While Kirk is robbing the safe, Janet Leslie, daughter of one of the conspirators, enters, and Kirk forces her to marry him so that she cannot testify against him. Kirk succeeds in reconciling his father with his rivals and in winning his new wife's love.

title: A Bit of a Stranger
description: Four generations of Ukrainian women from one family explore how their ethnic identity has been destroyed and embark on an emotional journey shaped by their new found memories and family history.

title: A Glória e a Graça
description: Graça is a single mother who works as a massage therapist and lives with her two children: Moreno, 8, and Papoula, 15. One day, in a visit to the doctor, Graça is diagnosed with a brain aneurism that may rupture at any moment. Desperate about who will take care of her kids in the event of her death, she decides to go after her brother, Luiz Carlos, whom she hasn't seen in over 15 years due to a quarrel. When they meet, however, Luiz Carlos has become Gloria, a beautiful and successful transvestite, who now owns a restaurant and brags about being independent. At first, Gloria is unwilling to reconnect with her family; but as she becomes more guilt-stricken, she accepts Graça's invitation to meet her nephews and eventually realizes that maybe, to be complete, she needs to become a mother.

title: A Day at a Time
description: Alba and Anastasia are twins with cerebral palsy who touched the heart of President Clinton with their plea for equal access. They come from an extraordinary family where everyone is determined the twins will be included in all activities. The fact that they are both in wheelchairs does not keep them from school, summer camp, or church. Their mother, Mary, thinks nothing of carrying them up and down several flights of stairs in their wheelchairs. She is a woman in constant motion, bathing, dressing, feeding and taking pleasure in seeing the twins are attractively dressed. She uses her tenacity and charm to assure that her children receive all the medical and educational benefits to which they are entitled. The filmmakers became close to the family, capturing the milestones of their lives: a birthday party, days at summer camp, their joyous first communion in church. Filmed over a period of four years, this unforgettable story will inspire everyone concerned with the challenges of family life and the place of disabled children in our society.

title: A Day in a Life
description: Paris. Gabrielle and Enzo, two teenagers from the same gang, meet in front of the school. Cigarettes, the affirmation of sexual desire and the discovery of new drugs punctuate their day. Each one, in his own way, celebrates or laments childhood that is slipping away.

title: A Wolf for a Spell
description: The Girl Who Drank the Moon meets Pax in this fantastical tale of a wolf who forms an unlikely alliance with Baba Yaga to save the forest from a wicked tsar. Since she was a pup, Zima has been taught to fear humans - especially witches - but when her family is threatened, she has no choice but to seek help from the witch Baba Yaga. Baba Yaga never does magic for free, but it just so happens that she needs a wolf's keen nose for a secret plan she's brewing... Before Zima knows what's happening, the witch has cast a switching spell and run off into the woods, while Zima is left behind in Baba Yaga's hut - and Baba Yaga's body. Meanwhile, a young village girl named Nadya is also seeking the witch's help, and when she meets Zima (in Baba Yaga's form), they discover that they face a common enemy. With danger closing in, Zima must unite the wolves, the witches and the villagers against an evil that threatens them all. "Karah Sutton has crafted a vivid and rollicking adventure that proves a wolf doesn't have to be big or bad to win the day!" title: Studio C

title: C³: C Cube
description: Yachi Haruaki is a high school boy who is naturally resistant to curses. She's the human form of the cursed black cube - and an instrument of torture! Utilizing her special abilities, Fear fights alongside Haruaki to defeat other cursed instruments and their owners.

description: After his father dies, Kane is taken in by Eve, a gym owner. Bullied as a janitor, he hides his skills until gangsters threaten the gym. Months later, the gym thrives. Kane and Eve find family and purpose together.

title: Shadow Punisher
description: The Great Dynasty, which had been in good luck for 37 years, was about to usher in a long planned bloody storm. Puppet secret techniques, Changsheng Demon Luo, Winged Poison Worm, Mirror Flower Water Moon, and the Teacher of Form and Man appeared one after another. The "Five Absolute Mysteries" revived with the help of the defeated country's Li Luo, creating a series of shocking and mysterious cases. The group of divine catchers led by Li Si, under the direct jurisdiction of the Imperial Power, resolutely opened the curtain of their life and death struggle against the remnants of Li Luo in order to ensure the safety of the mountains and rivers and the well-being of the people.

title: C-Suite TV Insights
description: C-SUITE TV INSIGHTS is a program that takes you inside the minds of the most respected visionaries, thought leaders and entrepreneurs in the world.

title: My Unicorn Girl [Hindi]
description: When she was eighteen, Sang Tian makes a wish to enter her mother's school to become part of the Chinese figure skating team. However, she did not pass the ranking test but somehow disguises as a guy and was accepted into the Ice Hockey team. Having no choice, she adopted a new identity. However, her plan was foiled by the sudden appearance of Wen Bing. Wen Bing and Sang Tian become room-mates. After one encounter, the two former "arch enemies" suddenly become good friends. The two of them decide to work together with their team mates and do their best in the championships. However, Sang Tian's secret was eventually exposed. Despite this, she still gets the chance to become a member of the first all-female Ice Hockey team. Sang Tian is finally able to become a real girl and continue chasing her dream.

title: Against the sky Supreme [English]
description: The entire universe is divided into the inner universe and the outer universe. The two universes are enemies of each other. The outer universe is ruled by demons, and the inner universe is divided into The Realm of gods, the Eternal Realm, and the Mortal Realm. In the universe, there are countless mortal worlds like the Tianfa Continent, and they are collectively referred to as the Jiutian Xin Region. In the field of Jiutian Xin, nine immortal emperors commanded all star fields in nine layers. Above the nine heavens is the realm of purification of immortal gods.

title: Killing John F. Kennedy
description: John F Kennedy was one of America's greatest presidents. He was the voice of the people who was a natural public speaker and a cool calm figure in front of the cameras. His influence helped push America through the most dangerous moments of the cold war, diffusing what could have been world nuclear destruction. But in November 1963, his life would come to a devastating end through the hands of an assassin. But who would kill one of the most popular presidents? Why was he a target? Join us as we investigate the life and career of JFK and ask the question...Who was really behind the killing of JFK?

title: Swag G Style
description: Swag G Style follows the lives of six gay/bisexual men in Dallas, Texas. We explore their friendships, business lives and how they cope day to day with the stigma of being gay and black in America. G Style Swagg is a reality series that allows the viewer a inside look at the hearts of 6 friends dealing the complications of life from coming out or not, and how it affects their day to day dealings in love, friendships, family and business. The intent of the show is to build a bridge of tolerance between the gay and straight communities.

title: H£ir Hunt£rs
description: This series follows the work of a firm of Probate investigators, Fraser & Fraser, who trace surviving family members when somebody dies intestate so they can claim the cash before HM Treasury does.

title: H: Murmur
description: Serial killer Shin-Hyun gives himself up to police and confesses to committing a series of particularly horrifying murders of exclusively female victims. He is imprisoned and awaiting the death sentence but the killings continue, with the same characteristics of the Shin-Hyun serial killings. The case is re-opened when two more bodies are discovered, both pregnant women; one found in the city's landfill site and the other was horrifically murdered on a public bus. Detective Mi Yun (Yum Jung-Ah) and her newly-appointed partner Detective Kang (Ji Jin-Hee) are assigned to the case. Mi Yun and Kang have difficulty working with each other; their personalities and working methods constantly clash. Detective Kang goes about his new job buoyantly and enthusiastically. He follows a new suspect, Huh, and eventually catches him in the act of brutally murdering a woman in a crowded techno bar. Huh is taken into custody after Kang shoots and wounds him at the crime scene. Once again, the case seems to be solved with this spectacular arrest--yet the murders continue in copy-cat style. The police desperately hunt for new leads. They start an in-depth investigation of a Doctor Chu, who is Shin-Hyun's psychiatrist, but progress is frustrated when Dr Chu becomes a victim of the copy-cat killings herself. The murdered psychiatrist's former boyfriend, a fanatical character named Choi, quickly becomes the prime suspect. All the pieces are finally starting to fit together, and the case seems almost resolved. But all efforts are suddenly frustrated once again, when Choi takes his own life--but still, the killings continue. The case gets more complicated when even the police themselves appear to become suspects in the murders. In unraveling this mystery, everyone involved is pushed to the limits of human understanding.

title: I Razor
description: Told from the perspective of a former scientist turned wandering telepathic man-child, I Razor is the story of one man's quest to regain his lost humanity. Gregory Fleer, a young scientist who has developed a new brain-altering substance called I Razor, is transformed by his own experiment and must negotiate his way through a world twisted beyond recognition by his altered perceptions. The film begins with Dr. Fleer already transformed, and teamed with his equally afflicted companion The Professor, who possesses certain inexplicable magic powers. Together, the Sergeant and Professor experience visions, perform music, and take a dark journey through a world populated by a tribe of fellow "freaks" and their leader, the phantasmagoric Mother Skinny, along with her right hand subhuman creation, The Homunculus. When the Professor abandons the Sergeant, the Sergeant finds some solace in the natural world, but his yearning to reclaim what he believes to be his lost identity unwittingly draws him back into the fray of society, where a struggle between good and evil awaits him.

title: Sabina K.
description: Sabina, a divorced mother of two small children, falls in love with an old friend from the Bosnian war. The two plan to marry, but things go terribly wrong.

title: Twisted Tie
description: When a torrential downpour blocks his way home after work, rookie employee Seon U ends up spending the night at the apartment of Team Leader Kang, the boss he has always found intimidating. Seeing the normally cold, perfectionist Team Leader Kang at home without his glasses and completely off guard, Seon U feels an unexpected flutter of attraction. Later, while sharing wine after a shower, Kang's surprisingly teasing and provocative side emerges, pushing Seon U to finally give in to the rebellious feelings he had long kept suppressed. As the two begin a tense and secret office romance, the arrival of Assistant Manager Baek from a client company throws everything into a new phase. Holding the absolute weapon of a business contract between the companies, Baek pushes Team Leader Kang's jealousy and desire for control to their limits. Thus begins a tangled and dangerous story involving three men, where love, rivalry, power, and possessiveness become increasingly intertwined.

title: Crazy With a K
description: "Crazy With a K" ...is a semi-autobiographical web-series that unabashedly calls depression a disease. Creator, Joël René Scoville knows that no one likes to watch people go through depression, so she lets us laugh at her, cry with her, and experience her fight against the odds as she combats this illness. We follow JOEY through a few select moments in her life following her second divorce from the same guy. Her depression haunts her, but her friends and group therapy companions try to be there for her as she tries to figure out how to move on with her life while dealing with a failed suicide attempt and trying to remain somewhat constant for her three adult children.

title: Put k prichalu
description: Young Vasya finds a job on the sea rescue tow Kola, where he befriends a bunch of colorful characters: sailors Bruno and Marat and constantly depressed bosun Zosima. Kola gets a task to retrieve Polotsk, a ship, abandoned during the war.

title: Wir Sind vom K u K Infanterie-Regiment
description: A Viennese architect opposes his girlfriend's ambitions as a cabaret singer and turns away from her to do his duty in the infantry and prepare for war.

title: The Forbidden Marriage
description: Ye So-rang, a fraudulent match-maker insisting she can summon the deceased crown princess, shows up to King Lee Heon who proclaimed a ban on marriage since he lost his wife 7 years ago.

title: Don't F**k with Ghosts
description: Filmmaking duo, Adam and Stu are convinced they need to capitalize on the next paranormal phenomenon, attempting to prove that ghosts are real.

title: F#@K I Love U
description: F#@k I Love U is a dramatic tale of a modern family that gets quickly pulled into a spiral of interconnected events that test the limits of their bond and mutual love. Douglas Winston is, by all appearances, the perfect family man. A well groomed and successful black politician, he, his wife white Angie, and their two sons, James and Michael, seem to lead idyllic lives that quickly begin to unravel when Douglas visits his brother J, an white irresponsible would be actor with heavy drug and sex habits. After a jeopardizing incident endangers all of their lives, Douglas is quick to blame J and his irresponsible nature, but in trying to delve into the actual truth, the strands that hold his life together quickly start to unravel into a downward spiral of twisted connections, tangled love, and intrigue that will put to the test the true limits of his faith in those he loves and who he believes in.

title: Boy, with Caution
description: Ki-woo, who hasn’t been able to tell his mother about his marriage problems and has been bouncing from one contract job interview to another due to past rumors at school, meets “Lee Hyun-jae”—whose face is badly bruised—at Nakwon High School. Everyone tells Ki-woo, who is the son of the school’s chairman, “Don’t worry about him.” But Ki-woo begins to find Hyun-jae intriguing. Meanwhile, Hyun-jae realizes that Ki-woo—the only one who asks about his true feelings—is giving him “special treatment.” As he deliberately tries to hurt himself to get Ki-woo’s attention, he spots the anonymous chat app “Anyone” on Ki-woo’s phone. He intentionally starts chatting with Ki-woo, and…

title: Rock-N-America
description: Syndicated 1980's music video show that featured comedy sketches in between videos.

title: Switch Case N
description: An IT guy has things going well for him in his career and relationship but things change for the worse when he switches between companies. He has to deal with the change and learns to live with it.

title: Pete 'n' Tillie
description: Tillie dreads another blind date with Pete Seltzer, who hides his insecurities behind jokes and flirting. Though initially resistant, she gradually warms to him as their relationship develops into marriage.

title: Lock 'n' Load
description: A Vietnam vet has nightmares about murder and zombies, and then discovers that he and other vets have been programmed to commit crimes and then kill themselves afterwards so they can't be traced. He investigates to try to find out who is responsible.

title: Salle n° 8
description: In ward 8 of a Parisian hospital, patients come and go but the staff stay. There are Anne and Serge, the medical externs, Philippe, the resident, Madeleine, a nurse, Marc, the surgeon, Mamadou, the orderly, etc., shown in their daily life.

title: Romeo n' Juliet
description: Only one will survive. This is their story. William Shakespeare's immortal tragedy 'Romeo and Juliet' has remained vital through five centuries, and is now reborn and blooms in contemporary, post-Soviet Latvia. 25 years have already passed since Latvia regained its independence from the Soviet Union, yet it's facing urgent issues in the present day - two ethnic groups are living in separate communities, thus dividing one country in two. Shakespeare's play has never lost its urgency, proving its greatness in terms of genre and message. Now, "Romeo n' Juliet" depicts the contemporary love story of a young Latvian girl, Juliet, and a Russian guy, Romeo.

title: In 'n Out
description: A comical story of a scatter brained hero who is invited to his Pa's funeral. Never having known his father but still suspecting foul play, he travels to Mexico to learn the truth with hilarious results.

title: Suster N
description: A movie about the famous ghost of the Dutch raised nurse, Norah, who can not walk for having a wounded leg.

title: Chiquis 'n Control
description: Chiquis heads to New York City and confronts her shopping addiction only to return home to L.A. to face selling all her luxury goods to raise money for the salon.

title: Love N' Dancing
description: 2002: Jake Mitchell is the defending World West Coast Swing Champion. He's got everything going for him: looks, personality, and style. He's at the top of his game when he and his partner Corinne are crowned the unexpected winners at the World Swing Dance Championships. As the crowd cheers and the celebration begins, Jake appears uneasy. Did he really deserve to win? The music blasts and the bass is thumping, and Jake hears none of it. He feels it. Jake is completely deaf, due to an ear infection when he was a teenager. He learned how to dance by feeling the vibrations of the music. Now he feels something else: that perhaps the judges gave him the win out of sympathy. Present Day: Jessica Donovan's life is boring. When she was younger, she was a dancer who had dreams of Broadway. Now she's an English teacher for disinterested, upper class middle school kids, and she's dying to let loose. Her fiancee Kent is a work-a-holic who cares more about making money than making Jessica happy. Jake's moved on with his life and he's now a dance teacher who travels around the country doing motivational speaking to students about how his disability did not hold him back. It's at a school assembly where Jake and Jessica first meet. He's up on stage telling kids that you have to believe in yourself. The spoiled rich kids show no interest at first, but Jake's charm and sense of humor gets them to laugh. Then his former partner Corinne joins him onstage and they dance. The crowd goes nuts! Jake meets Jessica and there's an instant connection; there's only one problem. Jake's still in love with Corinne and perhaps always will be. And Corinne knows exactly how to get under Jake's skin. Though she has a fiancee, she drives Jake nuts with her flirtatious ways. Jessica initially asks Jake to train both her and her fiancee in West Coast Swing for their wedding, but Jake and Jessica are drawn closer when Kent's non-stop job prevents him from going to the class. Jessica decides to take lessons from Jake... perhaps they can compete at the World Championships of Swing in the Pro-Am division? And they get better and better. They decide, at a dance party, to go for it all. Forget the Pro-Am; they want to try for the title that Jake felt he never deserved. But now the champions are all 18 year olds who can defy gravity, and Jake's in his early thirties. title: Rock 'N' Roll Ringo
description: A scaffolding builder loses his job and starts as a temporary worker at the funfair. There he is seduced by a showman into making a career as a fairground boxer - and hopes to fulfill a long-awaited dream for his daughter.

title: Dom n° 8
description: The developmentally disabled children at Home No. 8 in Gorna Banya are rehearsing a musical-gymnastic number to celebrate June 1st, the International Day of the Child. The theme of the celebration is "Peace on Earth." During the course of their endless practice sessions, an obvious conflict arises between the their caregivers' rather absurd notions of peace and happiness and actual everyday life in the care home. By the end, one of the children has reached 18 years of age and in accordance with the rules must be moved to a new home: Home No. 6.

title: Mzungu (n.) White-Wanderer
description: This feature length documentary, Mzungu, is our story about personal change, sacrifice, adventure, and ultimately the power of love and community. You will embark on a journey into the great joys and perils of Africa through the eyes of four-young-naive and unassuming Americans. As we join Scott, Eric, Dan, and Adam on their crusade to 'save the world', you too may just fall in-love with Uganda and Rwanda, meet some new friends, and change your life for the better. These young men aren't on a vacation, they have gone to work hard, to 'help', doing what they know best. They will visit Internally Displaced People camps and witness the short and long term effects of genocide and tribal wars. They gain a new understanding of the immense devastation HIV/AIDS is creating across the continent of Africa.. But in the course of making life- long friends, as well as, facing the loss of life, the viewer is on this journey as well. We hope you will also laugh, cry, sing, dance, and in the end leave Africa completely different people. In a time when social entrepreneurs and global issues rule the media, this documentary is a truly raw and real look into a once-in-a-lifetime journey that turns into an entire world of friends working together. The power of this film lies in the questions it forces us to ask ourselves. Are we doing enough, what if it's too hard to help people, what does it mean to love people we've never met? Yet, in the end, you too will may start to believe the world can be a better place and that it is up to you to change it!

title: Stories N' Steel
description: A fresh take on automotive reality TV, each episode features builders, collectors and craftsmen telling their stories through lively discussion and visual examples of their passions.

title: Vincent N Roxxy
description: A small town loner and a rebellious punk rocker unexpectedly fall in love as they are forced on the run and soon discover violence follows them everywhere.

title: O Bebê Gênio Salva o Papá
description: Após um contratempo médico, a virgem Violet Gray engravida do filho de um bilionário desconhecido para ela, Carter Watts. Pensando no filho, os dois se veem obrigados a se casar de forma apressada. Carter viaja a trabalho e fica fora por 6 anos, durante os quais Violet cria seu filho, Patrick, completamente sozinha enquanto trabalha em um hotel 5 estrelas. Inesperadamente, o hotel é adquirido por um novo e misterioso proprietário — o mesmo Carter! No entanto, após 6 anos separados, eles já não se reconhecem. Por acaso, Violet descobre que seu encantador chefe, Carter Watts, é, na verdade, seu marido perdido...

title: O Parto Que Destruiu o Chefão
description: Grávida de nove meses, Alessia é mantida em cativeiro pelo próprio marido, Vito Falcone, que a obriga a adiar o parto para garantir que o filho da viúva de seu irmão nasça primeiro e herde o território da família. Ignorando seus apelos e colocando a vida da esposa e do bebê em risco, Vito escolhe proteger a outra mulher. Quando finalmente decide libertá-la, já é tarde demais: Alessia e o filho desapareceram, deixando-o diante das consequências irreversíveis de sua traição.

title: O Grão
description: The elderly Perpétua, feeling the approach of death, decides to prepare Zeca, her beloved grandson, to the inevitable. She tells him the story of a king and a queen, a wealthy and powerful couple who lost their only child but wishes to bring him back to life. Meanwhile, Damião e Josefa work hard to support their family and to prepare their daughter Fátima's wedding. At the end, the tale told by Perpétua and the destiny of that family will cross.

title: O gabros mou, o dikigoros!
description: A barber wants to marry his daughter to a scientist. He believes that he has found the proper candidate in the face of a trainee lawyer.

title: O Desejado
description: João is the spiritual heir (the term he prefers to bastard) of Manuel Brandão, his dying godfather, and at the same time the political leader of a small party of a disintegrating governmental coalition.

title: O retorno da luz - o início
description: In 1986, 21 unidentified flying objects were detected by the radars in Brasília and São Paulo, and 5 fighters took off to intercept them. A girl is born from this moment and, 10 years later, a second one, with different views of the world, ability to heal and move objects, and much superior intelligence, which can affect everything and everyone around her, bringing with them, the return of light.

title: O Liberdade
description: The documentary talk about a magic place, the heart of the bohemian in Pelotas, southern Brazil. The Samba, Choro, and all the popular culture.

title: O Touro
description: A Portuguese girl arrives at the Lencois Island, in Brazil, curious about this new place surrounded by huge white sand dunes. Its residents are all descendants of King Don Sebastian, who disappeared in the 16th Century.

title: O... Çocuklari
description: Turkey is under the yoke of the military regime. Unbelievable events will develop in the axis of the house of the custodian mother, who takes care of the children of prostitutes.

title: O Fascínio
description: O FASCÍNIO is an intriguing story about a family and a manor house (where some terrible crimes were committed in the past by a member of that family) adapted from a novel with the same title by Tabajara Ruas.

title: O tetraperatos
description: A vibrant cafe owner struggles to attract the girl of his dreams. Who knows, with a bit of luck and sharp wits, life can sometimes be a bed of roses.

title: Ter o Céu, Pagar o Inferno
description: Kíria, a Imortal do Kirin, recebeu um favor do Senhor Lima. Em troca, deu-lhe uma joia do desejo. Anos depois, o filho dele, Henrique usou a joia para pedir um filho. Kíria transformou-a numa Pérola da Concepção e, com seu poder, fez Helena, a mulher dele, engravidar de um menino. Henrique venerava Kíria, mas Helena, pensando que ela era uma filha ilegítima do marido, virou-se contra ela.

title: O papatrehas
description: With six sisters on the verge of marriage, a desperate spinster aunt, and an entire block of flats depending on him, an indefatigable concierge is making plans for the future; however, he must first find suitable husbands for his siblings.

title: O Lobisomem
description: A millionaire lives in a sinister cottage where strange events unfold. A damned creature, he transforms himself in a werewolf and leads a following whose adepts spread horror and despair in the neighboring city, becoming themselves a clan of assassins. One day, the werewolf confronts Branca Justiça (White Justice), who summons benign forces to scathe them and frees him of his own wickedness.

title: O Magnata
description: In São Paulo, the upper middle class punk-singer Andre a.k.a. Magnata spends his time in the periphery with his friends from the lower class, singing in clubs and wasting his inheritance. When he is challenged by his friends to steal a Ferrari from a store, he accepts the challenge and he goes with his pal Chivitz. They rob the car and after driving for fun, Magnata goes to the stage for a concert and asks Chivitz to get rid off the car because it would be located through the GPS system. However, Chivitz decides to drive more and is arrested by the police. Meanwhile, Magnata meets Adriana Melo, who has just arrived from New York, with his friend Renata that invites him for her birthday party on the next day. Magnata dates Adriana and falls in love for her, but this reckless prank stealing the Ferrari leads them to a tragic consequence.

title: O Donzelo
description: In the countryside, the virgin hick Nestor sees a naked model taking pictures and chases her through the fields and village. His father decides to pay for the services of the local prostitute Marli, but Nestor feels repulse for the whore and his father expels him from the village. Nestor travels by foot and hitchhiking and along his journey, he meets his cousin; the young prostitute Janete "Tutuquinha" in a brothel; the young Dulce that is participating of a scavenger hunt in her Fiat No. 18; the charming actress Leila; but their encounters do not meet his expectation and Nestor does not lose his virginity. When he arrives in Rio de Janeiro, he is arrested and in the jail he meets a travesty. When he is released, he finally fulfills his mission.

title: O anakatosouras
description: A string of bizarrely improbable coincidences upset the balance in the orderly life of a meek employee, as the sudden appearance of a self-confident doppelgänger leads his family to false assumptions. But, who is this mysterious "other"?

title: O Papa que Venceu o Comunismo
description: When a cardinal who had been considered harmless by the Soviet Union is elected Pope, he initiates a spiritual revolution that challenges and destabilizes communism, culminating in the fall of an empire.

title: P.S. I Love You [Hindi]
description: A young widow discovers that her late husband has left her 10 messages intended to help ease her pain and start a new life.

description: Pipo the Clown receives a letter from his aunt. She tells him the castle which lies nearby her house, is haunted. Pipo leaves the circus to visit the castle. Things aren't what they seem and a race against time begins.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Dedma sa ex na kumakatok at may pasalubong na paulit-ulit na pasakit. But, hello sa grupong nagbabalik sa "It's Showtime" entablado para pagandahin ang araw n'yo. Napaindak ang buong nation sa performance at taas ng energy ng P-Pop group VXON.

Dazzling sa pagrampa sina Miss Q and A Resbakulawan candidates Andrea Jane Peralta, Jers Sabado, at Mama Dhel. Dahil Resbakulawan, diretso nang sumalang ang tatlo sa Wit Lang. Pagkatapos, sina Andrea at Jers ang umabante sa BEKLAMATION.

Na-impress si hurado Nicole Cordoves, pero aminadong nakulangan nang kaunti sa 'chukchak' ng dalawang ladies. Kaya para iwas-bitin, pati si Vice Ganda ay tumalak na rin! Sa huli, itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era Resbakulawan daily winner si Andrea.

Hindi na kailangan pang tumama sa lotto para masabing lucky sa araw na 'to! Dahil swerte agad ang lumapit sa mga taga-San Isidro, Cainta Rizal na bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa "It's Showtime."

Walang mapapagod kakatawa sa mga challenges sa game arena. Sa paboritong Act-Song portion sa You Gotta Lyric round, time-out muna sa kilig scenes sina Brent Manalo at Jackie Gonzaga dahil magkapatid muna sila sa isang eksena ng family drama.

Hindi naman horror story ang pagsali ni player Pao. Dahil matapos ma-eliminate, nabunot ang pangalan niya upang maglaro sa jackpot round dahil bigo ang mga naunang players na ma-secure ang spot.

Ramdam ni Vice Ganda ang matinding pangangailangan ni Pao, isang siomai vendor na nag-iipon para sa kanyang operasyon sa mata dahil sa kondisyon na keratoconus. Ramdam din nito ang puso ng manlalaro. Kaya para bang binigyan niya ito ng lakas ng loob na sugalan ang POT question.

Pigil ang hininga ng Madlang People at lahat ng nasa studio, hanggang sa isinigaw ni Pao ang sagot. Bumuhos ang emosyon at saya nang i-anunsyo ni Vice Ganda na tama ang sagot ni Pao at maiuuwi nito ang P350,000 POT money.

title: Ang bilis naman! Papu, 'dumamoves' kay Nelds
description:
Minsan, life imitates fiction, 'ika nga. Ang mga eksenang akala mo sa pelikula lang nakikita, pwede rin palang mangyari in real life. Kung nakaranas ka na ng mala-romcom scene sa totoong buhay, eh di ikaw na, siguradong makaka-relate ka sa bagong harana ng P-Pop group VXON. Bukod sa kuwento tungkol sa kanilang bagong awitin, may bitbit din silang pa-kilig sa mga fans as they celebrate their 4th anniversary!

Hindi pa man nagsisimula ang games sa Laro laro Pick, ang mga lola't lolo na players, muntik nang magbardagulan sa pag-aagawan ng puwesto. Vice Ganda to the rescue!

Nakuha naman ni Nelds ang atensyon ng mga tao sa studio dahil sa mga kuwento niyang walang preno. At ano itong chika na nagkayayaan na sila ni Papu na mag-date? Sa kanilang kulitan, may nasabi si Nelds na tiyak iyong ikagugulantang, kaya si Meme, napahingi na lang ng paumanhin sa MTRCB.

Laugh trip din ang mga eksena nang si Vice Ganda'y mamalikmata. Napagkamalan si Papu na isang personalidad na umano'y "nagtatago," o para ring "roll on na nagpapawis." Kinilala rin nila si Beth, na nagtuturo sa mga batang may ADHD. Teka, nanggigil si Meme! Bakit kasi ang dami niyang kapareho ng OOTD?!

But the luckiest of them all ay si Loi! Mahirap man ang buhay, positibo pa rin ang panananaw ni nanay. And with that positivity, tama lang na sugalan ang POT question baka sakaling masungkit nag P200k POT money.

Sa pagbubukas ng panibagong yugto sa Ika-10 Taon ng 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan,' matutunghayan naman natin ang talento ng mga taga-Region 5.

Hinarana ni Isaiah ang Madlang People sa studio, singing "Binibini" by Zack Tabudlo. Nabilangan man ng "isa" ni hurado Jonathan Manalo, hindi siya nawalan ng confidence sa entablado.

Ang 18-year-old contender na si Paulene, mahusay mag-majorette. Pero ang panalo sa TNT, hindi niya na-get! Na-gong ang mang-aawit sa hudyat ni Punong Hurado Bituin Escalante, na naniniwalang na-pressure ang kalahok na pretty. Sabi nga ni hurado Jonathan, "do not second-guess yourself."

Relate si Darren Espanto sa rejection na na-experience ni Paulene, kaya napa-reminisce siya about his "The Voice Kids" era, at in-encourage si Paulene na sumubok muli.

description: This film is an update of Jean Cocteau's Orpheus, set in the world of 1980s rock.

title: Bigyan ng P150k 'yan! Tatay Wil, nasagot ang POT question!
description:
Kilig-kiligan ang kantahan sa “It’ Showtime” dahil isang mapusong harana ang hatid ng “Tawag Ng Tanghalan” male champions na sina JM Yosures, Reiven Umali, Christian Tibayan, Yannie Basical, at JM Dela Cerna. Bumisita rin sina “PBB Gen 11” alums Jarren Garcia at Dingdong Bahan para sa maghatid ng good news sa kanilang fans.

Ang mga sagot ng kandidata, siguradong pag-uusapan dahil sa Miss Q and A, intense na naman ang talakan. Bagay sa korona ang pangalan ng mga kandidatang sina Kylie Prinsesa at Princess Vajar. Pero si Candidate #3 na naiiba, Noriel Rodriguez Nabing, feeling daw niya siya ang wicked stepsister.

Itinaas ng mga ‘accla’ ang kanilang bandera as they proudly shared na malaya nilang nagagawa ang mga bagay na limitado sa mga ‘beki’ noon. Ang isang simpleng halimbawa na nabanggit ni Vice Ganda, ang mga beki raw noon ay expected na matutunan ang larong basketball, na kilala bilang sports na panlalaki. Pero ang mga beki ngayon, nakakapili na ng sports na gusto nila. Kaya na-open up ni Meme Vice ang 'unsettled grief' ng mga bakla noon.

Lighthearted kuwentuhan din ang pinagsaluhan ng mga Miss Q and A at "It's Showtime" hosts nang mabanggit ng isang kandidata ang lovelife niya. Binalikan ng "It's Showtime" family ang kanilang mga first love at old-school ways para magpapansin kay crush.

Pwede nang mangarap dahil may kulay at saya ang buhay para sa mga taga-Maricaban, Pasay. Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, lumaban sila nang sabay-sabay. Pero sa challenges, hindi pwedeng sumablay.

Aliw naman ang aktingan sa Act-Song round na You Gotta Lyric. Si Ion Perez, minulto ni Emilio Daez? At heto pa ang mas matinding plot twist, si Ogie Alcasid humingi ng kiss kay Vhong Navarro!

Ang player na nagtagumpay sa mga challenges hanggang dulo ay walang iba kundi si Marlon. Dahil gusto ni Vice Ganda na madagdagan ang pera ni Marlon, binigyan niya ito ng pagkakataon na sagutin ang POT question.

title: Jhong at Sarina, sanib-pwersa sa pag-SAMPLE
description:
Bugtong-bugtong, may korona ang hari, may kandila ang cake. Birthday ng Sample King kaya ang buong "It's Showtime" stage ay na-shake. Kasama ang unica hija na si Sarina, ipinagdiwang ni Jhong Hilario ang kaarawan niya.

Bago magsimula ang Miss Q and A segment, it's time para sa inaabangan din na kumustahan at chikahan ng trio nina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario. Mula sa puksaan ng kasuotan hanggang sa asaran ng edad, lahat na 'ata napag-usapan ng magkakaibigan.

Samantala, mga dalubhasa sa pagtalak sina Miss Q&A candidates Dhey Pascual Abital, Beshie, at Erwina Tirambulo. Kung sa nakaraang episode ay nagpakilala ang mga kandidata at hosts with their love status, ngayon naman ay pabonggahan sila ng intro borrowing the acronyms of executive agencies sa Pilipinas.

DOJ, as in Diretso ang Opinyon, Jaw-dropping ang perfromances ng mga kandidata sa pagsagot sa pageant questions. Sina Dhey at Beshie ang umabante sa Wit Lang round.

Bumoses si Dhey tungkol sa pagbabayad ng buwis at epekto ng korapsyon as she answered the question, "Kung kinain ka na ng sistema, may nakuha ba silang sustansya?" It's better to give than to receive naman ang talak ni Beshie sa tanong na, "Kung binabalot ka ng kalungkutan pwede ka bang iregalo?"

Hindi 'to kuwentong barbero. Totoong nag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga masisipag na barberong swabe ang dating. Time out muna sa paggamit ng gunting, sa pagsayaw at pagsagot muna nila ipapakita ang galing.

Enjoy ang hosts sa kuwentuhan kay Jun, ang loving hubby at daddy, na pangarap mapagpatapos ang anak sa kolehiyo. Dahil sa pangarap ni Jun, nakaramdamn ng lungkot si Vice Ganda. Naisip niyang sa Pilipinas, itinuturing na "pangarap" ang diploma, pero kung tutuusin ito ay "basic need na dapat naibibigay sa lahat ng mga bata.

Give na give ang players sa mga challenges sa game arena, hanggang sa may isang natira, si John. May pabaon na swerte ang kanyang buntis na misis. Nakapag-uwi si John ng P40,000 matapos tanggapin ang offer. Nanghinayang nga lang si John dahil alam niya ang sagot sa POT question. Kaya dinagdagan ni Vice ng P10,000 ang papremyo ng barbero.

title: Miss Q&A Nadimunyo Lustre
description:
Positive lang ang vibes sa August 11 episode ng "It's Showtime" dahil birthday ng nag-iisang Sample King, Jhong Hilario. At ang wish niya ay hindi lang para sa sarili kundi for everybody. Eyyy!

As colorful as the rainbow rin ang kilig na bumuhos sa studio dahil sa performance ng isa sa mga paborito nating musical duos—JM Dela Cerna at Marielle Montellano, na may bagong anthem perfect para sa mga naghahanap ng lambing, titled "Perfect Together."

Kung ito ay isang color palette, bright ang bawat shade na hatid ng Miss Q and A candidates. Meet Heaven Jumawan, na head-turner ang beauty. Comedy naman ang forte ng comedy bar performer na si Senyora Acero Kabakal. Ibang 'amats' din ang baon ni Nadimunyo Lustre, na asset ang out-of-this-world na mga ngiti.

Maya-maya pa, nagsimula na ang unang round, Tumpak Ganern, kung saan unang nakasagot si Heaven. At ang nakalaban ni Heaven sa Wit Lang? Eh, 'di si Nadimunyo!

Pinalakpakan ang talak ni Heaven sa tanong na, "Sino ang mas gusto mong nag-a-update sayo—jowa mo o NDRRMC?" Pero panggulat ang naging chukchak ni Nadimunyo sa tanong na, "Anong pipiliin mo—otsenta anyos ka na pero wala kang jowa, o may jowang otsenta anyos?"

Ang mga players of the day sa Laro Laro Pick, sanay sa industriya ng hospitality. Maging warm din kaya ang welcome sa kanila ng swerte? Makilaro muna kasama ang mga receptionists ng Makati.

Panalo agad sa tawanan ang kuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda at player Chinn, ang receptionist ng Glowingly Yours salon. Nataranta naman si Neo dahil sa hotel na kanyang pinagtatrabahuan, may dumating na dalawang artista. Ano ang ggawin niya kapag nag-check in sina Ogie Alcasid at Vice Ganda?

Pagkataos ng tatlong rounds ng masayang laro, si Rovie ang umabot hanggang dulo. Hindi na pinahaba pa ni Vice Ganda ang tawaran, dahil desidido si Rovie—kahit anong mangyari, POT ay kanyang susugalan!

#ShowtimeLaroTogether
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Loud ang cheers at concert feels sa June 16 episode ng "It's Showtime," as Ryan Bang performed some of the best OPM hits sa isang masayang birthdayprod, na nagpaindak sa mga manonood.

Araw-araw ay parang grand celebration ng mga 'beki' na hatid ay good vibes. Sa Day 2 ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A," muling umulan ng tawanan kasama ang sangkabaklaan.

Nagpasiklaban sina Contestant 1 Michelle Calamity, Contestant 2 Kelly Agustin, at Contestant 3 Linda Walker. Kung si Vice Ganda ang kahulma ni Michelle, si Jhong Hilario naman daw ang kamukha ni Contestant 2. At kung fairytale ang kuwento for today’s video, si Kelly ang prinsesang napapaligiran ng wicked stepsisters.

Sa unang round, ligwak si Contestant 1, pero pangako niya, she will return better and fiercer than ever. Sa pabonggahan naman ng wit sa ikalawang round, full of confidence ang pagsagot ni Linda, at pak na pak ang opinyon ni Kelly. Proving that she's got both beauty and brains, nasungkit ni Kelly ang bilib ng judges na sina Karylle, Ralph de Leon at Nicole Cordoves. Si Kelly ang itinanghal na Reyna Talak-Era of the day!

Palaki nang palaki ang papremyo sa game arena, kaya naman ganado sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga senior citizens ng Tandang Sora.

Agaw-eksena ang rakistang si Bro, na um-skip muna sa isang mahalagang pag-uwi sa probinsya para makapaglaro sa studio. Si Vice Ganda naman ang maintenance nina Lola Nene at Edith dahil makita lang siya, sapat na para sumaya!

Dahil ginalingan at kinapitan ang swerte, sa jackpot round, si Tatay Roger ang umabante. Pagpapataya ng 'ending' ang kanyang pinagkakakitaan. Katulad ng hanapbuhay ni tatay, kailangan sumugal para makuha ang jackpot money na P200,000.

Siguradong may isang lolo na happy dahil si tatay Roger ay may maiuuwing P30k, matapos tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer.

title: Miss Q and A
description:
Here to brighten your day, bumisita si Iñigo Pascual para haranahin tayo sa kanta niyang "Ikaw At Ikaw." Ikaw na, Iñigo! Ikaw na ang kakasa sa "Oooh Lala Baby" dance challenge!

Ang mga Miss Q and A ladies, nag-transform from kandidata to comedians real quick! Nagharapan sa talakan sina Iya Zaga Arkanghel ng Laguna, Miss Mia ng Bulacan, at Toni Fowler ng Cavite.

Pinalakpakan ang kanilang galawan at confidence sa rampahan. Ang ‘amats’ nilang tatlo, hindi kayang itago! Pati si Vice Ganda ay naloka sa sagot ng mga kandidata. Kelan pa nging ‘fishda’ ang ingles ng bangus? Nawindang din si Meme sa dilim ng kili-kili ni Toni! Maya-maya pa, sina Iya at Miss Mia ang umabante sa Round 2. Sino ang mas aangat sa talakan?

Salamat sa kanilang sipag, napapanatiling malinis ang ating paligid. Kaya naman deserve nila ang bumida sa 'Laro Laro Pick game arena. Sila ang mga madlang utility workers.

Sa kuwento ni Berto, parang may nag-awoo! Bilang utility worker sa isang ospital, sanay na siya sa mga paramdam, hindi ng ex na nang-ghost, kundi ng mga kakaibang 'nilalang' na paikot-ikot, patakbo-takbo sa ospital na kanyang pinagtatrabahuan.

Kung tumaas ang 'yong balahibo sa kwento ni Berto, tataas naman panigurado ang level of happiness mo sa magulong aktingan sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Parang pelikula na kumpleto ang casting, sanib-pwersa sa pag-Act-Song ang paborito nating quadro—Vice Ganda, Anne Curtis, Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario.

Ang mommy of walo na si Riz ang umabante sa final stage ng laro. Swerte nga ba ang numerong otso? Nag-goodbye si Nanay Riz sa Li-Pot offer na P35,000, para sugalan ang P25,000 POT question.

description: A story about a man who is skeptical of being alive and explores absurdity. He is informed that he had a daughter ,who died recently. He accepts his existence by thinking about her life.

title: Miss Q&A 3rd Weekly Finals
description:
Matutuloy na ang pagkikita ng dalawang icons ng noontime at komedya, 'Meme' Vice Ganda at 'Bossing' Vic Sotto. Samantala, mga Miss Q and A weekly finalists ang ka-date mo, at siguradong ma-i-in love ka sa mga talak nilang spot-on at matatalino. Unang tapak pa lang sa entablado, agad agad ay ready to slay and give their best sina Bb. Talinghaga, Rhain Boyonon, Mama Dhel, Jers Sabado, Raux Araneta, at Agua Gonzales.

Nasubok ang kaalaman ng ladies sa mga tanong na may kinalaman sa mga sangay ng gobyerno. Sina Mama Dhel at Rhaine ang 'chumukchak' sa final round, kung saan hinarap nila ang tanong na, "Sinong mas matalino? Ikaw o AI?"

Matalino ang sagot ni Rhain, na itinanghal na Miss Q&A TalakiTalk of the week!

Ang kabataan na masipag at may pangarap sa buhay, siguradong magtatagumpay. Mga estudyang kumukuha ng vocational courses, sumugal sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Enjoy ang kuwentuhan with Dagul, na ipinagmamalaki ang skills sa carpentry. Isinabuhay naman ni Dominick ang salitang versatility dahil sa dami ng talent na entry.

Pinaghandaan naman ng It's Showtime hosts act-song entries nila sa You Gotta Lyric round. May moment ang DaCkie tandem nina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga. At sina at MC at Lassy, bagay rin ba na maging mag-jowa?

Pito ang naka-survive sa It's Giving, pero isa lang ang nakapasa sa You Gotta Lyric, at ito ay si Ced. Pangarap niya, magkaroon ng malaking ambag sa pamilya. At ito na nga 'yun! Naniniwala siyang malaking ambag na ang P20,000 kaya tinanggap ni Ced ang nasabing Li-Pot offer.

title: Barbie Bratz Ayuda nag-WALK OUT sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Nagbabalik to birit si ‘Tawag Ng Tanghalan’ champion Lyka Estrella, na tanghaling tapat pa lang ay kasintaas na ng sikat ng araw ang boses. Move, give way dahil ready na to slay sina Lucky Collins, Barbie Bratz Ayuda, at Eysi Vigo sa Resbakulawan wildcard round ng Miss and A.

Dahil Resbakulawan, diretso nang sumalang ang tatlo sa Wit Lang round kung saan nasubok agad ang kanilag talino at creativity. Ang Top 2 na sina Lucky at Barbie ay muling nag-face off sa Beklamation kung saan nasubok ang kanilang talak sa tanong na, "Okay lang ba sa'yo kapag jinowa ng best friend mo ang ex mo?" Magkaiba ang saloobin nina Lucky at Barbie, ngunit parehong may punto.

Sa dulo, si Barbie ang mas nanlamon sa entablado at wagi sa unang Resbakulawan, matapos makakuha ng score na 9.7 mula kina Max Collins, Ralph de Leon, at Yllana Aduana.

Heto pa ang isang pagbabalik. Ang kinagiliwan noon na 'Showtime' kid na si Yorme, napadaan to celebrate his birthday habang nanonood ng It's Showtime. At kahit saglit lang nasilayan, instant throwback feels at good vibes ang hatid niya sa sambayanan.

Samantala, kapag may emergency, sila ang umaaksyon at nagbubuwis ng buhay. Ngayong Lunes, energy nila ay rumaragasa sa game arena. Sila ag mga Madlang Rescuers na bumida sa Laro Laro Pick.

Pagkatapos ng mga eksenang nakakakiliti sa Act-Song round na You Gotta Lyric, si Chie lang ang naka-survive kaya siya ang umabante sa jackpot round kung saan matapang niyang sinugalan ang P300,000 POT question na, "Anong pangalan ng galaxy ang kinabibilangan ng ating solar system?" Ang tamang sagot ay Milky Way!

title: Vice, nawindang sa Miss Q&A! Nanawagan sa DepEd!
description:
Salubungin ang July with champion biritan kasama nina TNT Duets 2 champs Christian Tbayan at Arvery Lagoring. Nagkaisa naman ang mga 'accla' sa Miss Q and A segment. Ang kanilang chika, bawasan ang problema at dagdagan ang saya. Ipinanalo nina Pia Cayetatayno, Mama Dhel, at Samaya Jhay ang protesta kontra bad vibes.

Isa-isang inilatag ng mga kandidata ang mga paandar nilang intro, drawing laughter from the Madlang People in the studio. Si Vice Ganda, may napansin sa tatlong kandidata. Kung si Pia ay may mga matang ala Meryll Soriano, si Mama Dhel naman daw ay mukhang 'baby' na 36 years overdue.

Nang magsimula ang unang round, ang nasabi na lang ni Meme ay, "Diyos ko!" dahil sa sagot ng mga kandidata for today's video. Sa tanong na, "Ano ang plural ng salitang furniture?" sumagot ang isang kandidata, na para bang sure na sure, "Super furnitures."

Kaya si Meme, 'nanginig' at nag-react nang pabiro, "Nananawagan talaga kami sa Department of Education. Gumalaw na tayo."

Sina Mama Dhel at Samaya Jhay ang nagharap sa ikalawang round, Wit Lang. Ang pinusuan ng mga hurado ay si Mama Dhel bilang Miss Q and A Reyna TalakEra sa araw na 'to.

Pumuti man ang kanilang buhok, nananatili namang makulay ang sense of humor ng mga beloved lolo't lola from Meycauayan, Bulacan na nakisaya sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Mga 'veterans' as in veterans sa pagpapatawa naman ang nagsama-sama sa You Gotta Lyric round na bagong inaabangan ng "It's Showtime" fans. Madlang People ay napa-wow nang si Vice Ganda ay lumabas bilang MemeRimar! Aww!

Ang happy ending sa kuwentong 'to ay para kay Tatay Philip, na umabante sa dulo ng laro. Positive lang ang pananaw ni tatay sa buhay. Aniya, pumunta siya sa "It's Showtime" nang walang dala, kaya aalis siyang sapat na ang P30,000 na Li-Pot offer.

#JulyNaShowtime
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: Come on in, We're Dead
description: The true story of the The Young Brothers Massacre, 1932. The record for the most lawmen shot dead in the history of the United States. 10 cops and one civilian in Springfield, Missouri went to arrest 2 small-time gangsters known as The Young Brothers. The young men (Harry, 25 and Jennings, 30) had been on the run for the murder of a town marshall 3 years earlier. The Sheriff, Marcell Hendrix, had been neighbors with the fugitive?s family and late father in particular, so he didn't expect any trouble. As a consequence, they showed up at the family farm with nothing but the six-guns on their belts, and little to no additional ammo, In spite of the fact that the boys were well known for their marksmanship. The farm was on a large open piece of land with a scattering of trees around the farmhouse. When the Sheriff and his deputy pushed in the door, a massacre ensued, The officers would become trapped behind those trees, as the brothers systematically picked off the officers from the cover of the dark farmhouse.

title: S. O. S. - Spasite nase duse
description: The plot of this film can be viewed from a two different levels. The first is universal and deals with the psychological theme of need for competition in the group, highlighting the need for the victory, which in life usually does not depend on the true virtues of the winner, so the result is usually tragicomic. The story talks about the choice of the most noble work. Selected participants arrive at the guest house on the border between Croatia and Serbia to prepare for the final act of the competition and the jury's decision. Seven competitors have a rather narrow view of the world. Even when the big events, such as ethnic conflicts in this part of the Balkans, the contestants insist to proceed the competition and to choose the hero of heroes, even though the very idea of competition has become anachronistic under the pressure of current events (the anger of the local Serbian population of the newly established Croatian authorities).

On earth, a young girl, Kara, finding alienation in her school and home life, wanders to a nearby lake in dejection only to come across an unexpected friend, whom she names 'Dot-t' - a mysterious new arrival on planet Earth. But others, some with dark intent, are also looking for this exceptional creature while a media frenzy breaks about proof of life on other planets. Hiding Dot-t and staying just one step ahead of pursuers - some well-meaning, some driven by greed, becomes Kara's sole mission. Fleeing deep into a forest she is helped by a seemingly sinister woodsman, himself estranged from his family. This story of flight, hiding and escape is woven around the unique love of a young girl for a vulnerable new visitor to Earth, who soon proves to be more of a friend than anyone else on her home planet. Through the soft touch of a tentacle, Dot-t reaches out to revive our natural responses of tenderness and care. And perhaps draw closer, those who matter the most to us.

title: Drawn This Way
description: Drawn this Way (wt) is a one hour television documentary which dives into the pages of gay comic book characters and their creators. In the studio, in the comic book shops, at the fan-crazed conventions, and at home with the artists - we'll find out what it means to be a Doorq, how to come out of the closet as an HGN (hot gay nerd) and where our drawn adventures will take us next. When did all this g(art) start? Is it a sexual turn-on? How did the artists get their start? What do their families and friends think? Is it pornography? Why the obsession with these fantastical stories and characters? Are they taken seriously in the mainstream comic world?

title: Walad w Bent
description: A romance full of emotions, adventure and humor, the love of a lifetime is what the film is about. But between this boy and girl the story is not that simple. Although their bond is unbreakable they keep separating over the years. It's not circumstantial forces or even external pressures, but the very individuality of each is what keeps getting in the way in spite of all the love that's cherished within. In tracking their early zigzagged path the film delves into the complex and intricate web of inner conflicts that arise between young men and women of this age and ultimately innovatively poses the eternal question: Can Adam and Eve live happily ever after ?

Julian's mother died 6 years ago and although her husband promised her that he will never get married again, he broke this oath. The woman's ghost has not abandoned the house and is waiting for the punishment for her unfaithful spouse. It also influences Julian, who falls for his attractive stepmother. The doomed events constantly lead to a tragedy, which is about to happen...

title: X, Y & Z
description: After 3 years in a relationship with her now indifferent but well-off boyfriend X, a young girl named Y is ready to call it quits. X reacts by proposing marriage to Y in 3 months time. She desperately wants to leave her mother's house and accepts X's proposal. The next day Y meets Z at her "while I get married elementary school" job. As Z naively begins to court Y, a steamy affair quickly develops between them. Y's emotionally and financially desperate double-nature manifests itself when she is unable to choose between X and Z. As the wedding day approaches, true love and monetary security clash in modern day Latin America.

title: Y Pris
description: The series follows the tangled lives of a group of West-Walian gangsters. The drama centres on Lyn Edwards, who has responsibility thrust upon his shoulders when his father is taken ill. Lyn tries to juggle, a new girlfriend, family crises, a drug empire under threat, and the politics of the brotherhood - the ancient mafia organisation that runs everything in West Wales.

title: X, Y
description: Frankie dances topless in a sleazy little strip joint and drinks; it's the only way to get through the night. But then a mysterious man comes into the club, a piercing siren screams, and Frankie's world crumbles. In the morning, she isn't Frankie anymore. She doesn't remember who she is. She knows for certain only one solid truth: that she is a man. As for her boyfriend Terry, he cannot understand what his beautiful girl is trying to tell him. Frankie and Terry journey together through their private hell and transcend to the other side.

title: Balas y Diamantes
description: "Balas y Diamantes" cuenta la historia de una joven asiática secuestrada en su país de origen cuando era casi una niña y vendida junto a otras muchachas a un traficante en México quien no sólo las prostituyó, pero además, entrenó a algunas para que robaran para él. La joven logra fugarse con un botín de diamantes y escapar de México con la ayuda de un antiguo amante.

title: Tocar y luchar
description: To Play and To Fight presents the captivating story of the Venezuelan Youth Orchestra System - an incredible network of hundreds of orchestras formed within most of Venezuela's towns and villages. Once a modest program designed to expose rural children to the wonders of music, the system has become one of the most important and beautiful social phenomena in modern history. The documentary portrays the inspirational stories of world class musicians trained by the Venezuelan system, including the Berlin Philharmonic's youngest player Edicson Ruiz and world renowned conductor Gustavo Dudamel. With interviews with many of the world's most celebrated musicians including the great tenor Placido Domingo, Claudio Abbado, Sir Simon Rattle, Guiseppe Sinopoli, and Eduardo Mata, To Play and To Fight is an inspirational story of courage, determination, ambition, and love showing us that... only those who dream can achieve the impossible.

title: Luna & Ms Y
description: A lesbian art-world gore flick in which two ex-lovers meet after ten years.

title: Verdades y Mentiras
description: A drama about Maria whose fantasy takes into the surreal world of Cybersex, but the one night when she tries to make fantasy into reality danger lurks.

title: Sal y pimienta
description: Crossed paths, forms of love. Grandma Carmen's 80th birthday celebration will bring together several generations of women from the same family in a seaside hotel. A weekend, a family. Different paths, forms of feminism, ways of relating.

title: Olmos y Robles
description: In the quiet town of Ezcaray in Spain, police officers Olmos and Robles find themselves at ease beacuse there is no crime, until something horrible happe

title: Trampas y caretas
description: Carmen Mackenna is a multimillionaire and obsessive mother who only wants to see her two children, now in their thirties, married and stable. For this, she will use all the tricks at her hand, which in this case took the form of an attractive woman, Mariana, to whom she entrusts the job of making them fall in love and taking the one she loves the most to the altar, in exchange for a generous monthly check.

title: ...sol y lluvia
description: A young Venezuelan woman wants to become Miss Venezuela.

title: Pelucas y Rokanrol
description: Dino, a rocker, hair stylist and pedicurist gets entangled with Gina, a police sergeant in the popular neighborhood of Chapinero in Bogotá. His closest friends embark on a quest to help him and sometimes hinder his purpose of getting close to her. The music of the city of Bogotá at the time, accompanies their adventure and the visual noise of Chapinero becomes their peculiar background.

title: Azul y Blanco
description: Belonging to "brave bars" enemies in the exciting world of football, two fugitive lovers challenge everything.

title: Ángeles y querubines
description: A tragic celestial western that explores a surrealist point of view of the lost paradise by Adam and Eve.

title: Aprieta y gana
description: Battle of the sexes. Four female celebrities compete against four male celebrities in various games to win points, to win prizes, and to be declared the stronger sex.

title: Amor y pecado
description: Una bebita abandonada es recogida por una familia pobre compuesta por una madre sacrificada, el marido borrachín y dos niños, Manuel y Raúl. Los muchachos son el sostén de la casa. Ya grandes, los dos hermanos se enamoran de la joven, pero ella quiere a Raúl y ambos se comprometen. Al enterarse de esto, Manuel se dedica a la bebida y a las drogas.

title: Cañas y barro
description: Tonet lives an intense love story with Neleta, whom he has known since childhood, but the young man will be forced to leave the Albufera of Valencia and serve in the war in Cuba. During his absence, Neleta marries the rich innkeeper Canyamel. Upon the return of the war, Tonet and Neleta cannot avoid their adulterous relationship, provoking the talk of the people of the village.

title: Gregorio y su ángel
description: An alcoholic janitor is fired from his job at an orphanage, and is befriended by an angel in the guise of a little girl, who proceeds to change his life.

title: Intriga y Amor
description: Una médica que se llama Luisa Santos salvó al emperador, Óscar Guzmán. Pero Sabrina Lara, amiga de Luisa, asumió su identidad. Sabrina se convirtió en dama del palacio, y quería eliminar a Luisa. Mientras, Luisa fue promovida como vice jefa de la clínica imperial por su habilidad médica. Al enterarse de que Luisa estaba embarazada, Sabrina la calumnió. Afortunadamente, la verdad sale a la luz. Sabrina fue ejecutada. Los enamorados se casaron.

title: Secuestro y muerte
description: In 1970 in Buenos Aires, Argentina, former dictator Pedro Aramburu is kidnapped and interrogated by the newly born terrorist organization Montoneros.

title: María y yo
description: María lives with her mother May, in the Canary Islands, 3,000 km from Barcelona, where Miguel Gallardo has his home. Sometimes Miguel and María go on holiday together, spending a week at a resort in southern Gran Canaria, a rather unusual setting where the guests don't normally include a single father and his fourteen year-old autistic daughter. This is the story of one of their journeys, but above all it's an original tale, full of humor, irony and sincerity, about how to live with a disability.

title: Zona Y
description: A young generation of students struggle between friends, family, college and dreams.

title: Vigilantes y ladrones
description: The search for a hidden treasure in a hotel basement.

title: Pares y Nones
description: Three teens, one city, and endless partying. Joel, Olga, and Tavo, are searching for their place in the world caught between love, loss, and teenage angst. One night when they decide to break into an empty house destiny will take over and decide their real place in the world, if it can accommodate them.

title: Y: Marshals [Hindi] S1-S2
description: Ex-Navy SEAL Kayce Dutton leaves Yellowstone Ranch to join U.S. Marshals, using his cowboy and military skills to fight crime in Montana while dealing with family ties and the mental toll of law enforcement.

title: Generation Z
description: A web series following 5 diverse teens whose lives begin to intersect when they end up in a therapy/support group. We see their journeys in the program, the situations that landed them there, and their daily lives as teens in Generation Z.

description: The attempts of a middle-aged actress of bringing back her stardom.

title: Nejvetsi z Cechu
description: Film crew on the road: Director (Jaroslav Plesl), his Producer (Simona Babcáková), and their Director of Photography (Jirí Vyorálek) and Sound Arist (Johana Ozvold). Starving artists who already have a number of films to their names, Czech Lion award-winning films, excellent reviews and have been screened at numerous festivals, but they don't have audiences. Their next collaborative effort - the Director's lifetime dream - is quickly becoming oblivion because he failed to win a grant, which means it won't be made. And so the frustrated Director and his colleagues await their chance among record-holders of curious disciplines such as crawling with a squash racket or collecting four-leaf clovers. How will the collision of these two worlds end? What will the Director's next film be about?

title: Dimension Z
description: When the zombie apocalypse arrives, groups of survivors band together to defend themselves at any cost. Unfortunately for the remaining few, zombies have evolved into different species altogether and exist not just in this dimension but in a dimension of their own. With little hope, the humans gather strength for one last chance at saving their world in this intensely twisted anthology.

title: Everything for Sale
description: The disappearance of the leading actor from the film's set worries its director Andrzej. He embarks on a journey to look out for the actor with a young actor and missing actor's wife and mistress.

description: Having attended Mihama Academy for about a year, Yuuji Kazami has seemingly found his place within the school, but he suddenly decides to pursue a promotion in CIRS. After consulting JB about his intentions, they both thoroughly examine Yuuji's documents and dissect the events of his upbringing to determine if the job is fit for him. Meanwhile, unbeknownst to the two, the girls of Mihama uncover some torn documents in Yuuji's room. After restoring the papers, they discover the story that has formed, or perhaps broken, Yuuji into the man he is today. However, what was thought to be history has haunted him to the present, and the chains of the past begin to drag him back into the darkness.

title: Love at 0°C
description: Sun Yixin is an aspiring fashion designer but is unable to find a job. Her friend Xiaoling aspires to enter high society and marry a rich man's son and often drags Yixin along to high-class parties. Yixin's mother forces her to help out with her cleaning business. She is forced to do the cleaning herself when she discovers that the business is in debt due to her mother's negligence. Her first assignment was to clean the house of Hu Zhitao, an irascible old man who looks after his grandson with an iron hand and happens to be Guobin's father. Yixin and Hu Guobin were classmates at design school and share a love-hate relationship. She Weixiang and his partner Victor run a dinner dress rental and auction business. Although from a wealthy background, he is estranged from his father and detests him for having a mistress. By chance, Yixin bumps into them and her fashion expertise comes into handy. title: Riga (Take 1)
description: Riga, Latvia. Four women: Elita, an impassioned actress, Elina, her daughter, Iveta, a tourist guide and Paulina, a teenage ballet dancer. All are in love and going through strong emotions. A free-style composition about passion and arts, a visually stunning cinematic jazz partition.

title: 19  (a)
description: The mundane life of a woman running a photocopy shop goes into a tailspin when a revolutionary writer leaves the manuscript of his unpublished novel with her.

title: NieR:Automata Ver1.1a [English] S1-S2
description: Animated adaptation of NieR: Automata (2017), where a long-running war on post-apocalyptic Earth between androids and machines soon unveils the truth of the world.

title: Marco [Malayalam]
description: Marco, a Malayalam movie, is indeed a unique film that has created a buzz in the Indian cinema industry. The movie is a spin-off of the 2019 film Mikhael, and it focuses solely on the villain, Marco, played by Unni Mukundan. This is a rare occurrence in Indian cinema, where a sequel or a spin-off is dedicated entirely to the antagonist. The Concept of a Villain-Centric Movie Marco is the first Malayalam movie to have a sequel dedicated solely to the villain, without any connection to the hero of the original film. This concept is not new to world cinema, but it is a novelty in Indian cinema. The idea of exploring the backstory and character development of an antagonist is fascinating, and Marco seems to have taken this approach.

title: Marco [Kannada]
description: Marco, a Malayalam movie, is indeed a unique film that has created a buzz in the Indian cinema industry. The movie is a spin-off of the 2019 film Mikhael, and it focuses solely on the villain, Marco, played by Unni Mukundan. This is a rare occurrence in Indian cinema, where a sequel or a spin-off is dedicated entirely to the antagonist. The Concept of a Villain-Centric Movie Marco is the first Malayalam movie to have a sequel dedicated solely to the villain, without any connection to the hero of the original film. This concept is not new to world cinema, but it is a novelty in Indian cinema. The idea of exploring the backstory and character development of an antagonist is fascinating, and Marco seems to have taken this approach.
